semantics: Review metrics describe the bounded public analyst sample, not the accuracy of all Radar candidates and not phishing prevalence in Lithuania.

reviewCoverage.scope: Signals first published inside the stated window and represented in public history.

reviewLatencyHours.scope: First public observation to earliest supportable public assessment per signal.

currentExclusions.scope: Current sanitized exclusions have no public decision timestamp and are not in timed metrics.

precision.reason: The current public contract does not provide a complete, dated positive and negative review sample. A precision or false-positive estimate would therefore be misleading.

privacy: Aggregate counters only; no domains, URLs, signal identifiers, analyst identity or private notes.
